title: Linear-row locality windows for measured sparse SAT model search
claims: MeasuredLiteralSuffixMap and MeasuredSignedLiteralWindow implement canonical literal-suffix and signed window transforms.
MeasuredWindowSubsequences and MeasuredLocalityClauseUniverse generate all allowed window subsequences and give the exact row-count bound.
LocalityUniverseCoverage proves that each finite-set elimination-stage clause is represented by a signed occurrence window.
MeasuredWindowLocalityWitness uses the smaller generated universe to recover verified sparse models on the stated locality domain.

experiments.purpose: Bind all archived Lean overlay sources and the recorded exact statements to the local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports its live Lean invocation count, which may be zero.
